## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint, format, unit tests)
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (prerender and size budget)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes, or the change can't affect pages
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader still work for anything interactive I touched
- [ ] Checked with `prefers-reduced-motion` if I touched animation
- [ ] No visible copy changed without the owner's sign-off
